name: comp-44
title: OTP Input Grouped
blurb: 4-digit OTP input with slots grouped together.
description: An OTP field with 4 connected digit slots. Built with input-otp library. Slots are adjacent boxes with the active slot showing a ring.
use_when: Verification flows where users enter 4-digit codes and need clear visual slot grouping.
avoid_when: You need variable-length OTP or single-input OTP field.
a11y: Label linked to input. Active slot has ring focus indicator. Disabled state supported via group.
